description: A chair produced by Elm Furniture yields a profit of $43, while every dresser yields a $52 profit. Each week, 17 gallons of stain and 11 lengths of oak wood are available. Each chair requires 1.4 gallons of stain and 2 lengths of oak wood, while each dresser requires 1.1 gallons of stain and 3 lengths of oak wood. Determine the maximum profit.

AvailableStain.definition: Available gallons of stain per week

AvailableOak.definition: Available lengths of oak wood per week

StainPerChair.definition: Gallons of stain required to produce one chair

StainPerDresser.definition: Gallons of stain required to produce one dresser

OakPerChair.definition: Lengths of oak wood required to produce one chair

OakPerDresser.definition: Lengths of oak wood required to produce one dresser
